'''''Molator''''', originally known as '''''Savrip''''', was the first [[Vindicator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Vindicator''-class]] vessel that was not converted into an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]]. It served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]], and patrolled the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. ''Savrip'' was later captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and renamed '''''Molator'''''. The Rebels used this cruiser as an armed diplomatic vessel, sending it throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in search of more support for the Alliance.
